prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Pet Appearance & Photo Studio", "Upload photos of your ideal pet or select traits to create a personalized companion.", "Ensure clear lighting and a centered subject for best results.", "Upload Pet Photo", "Live Companion Preview"]
1: ["Ready to Welcome Your Desktop Companion!", "Your pet is prepared to enter your workspace. Review the quick interaction tips below."]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home", "We are assembling high-resolution animations and desktop physics for your companion.", "Asset Rendering Progress"]
3: ["Signing in automatically backs up and retains all your pets across devices.", "Sign In to Save & Sync Your Pets", "Connect your account to guarantee your desktop companion is never lost."]
4: ["Choose How You Want to Adopt", "Select a ready-made companion or create a custom pet tailored to your workspace."]
5: ["Official Desktop Adoption Certificate", "Name your new companion to grant them official citizenship on your desktop.", "You can change your pet's name anytime in settings.", "Official Adoption Seal"]
6: ["Your Companion Has Arrived!", "Your pet is now active on your screen. Click and drag them anywhere on your desktop.", "Arrival Chime", "First Interaction Checklist"]
7: ["Ready-made pets spawn instantly (30s). Custom photo pets take ~2 minutes.", "Select Your Adoption Journey"]
8: ["Secure Sign-In & Recovery", "Authenticating your account protects your pet progress."]
9: ["Spawning Companion in Background", "Feel free to minimize this window. We will alert you the moment your pet is ready on your desktop.", "Notification Alert"]
